thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — High 5xx rate detected on api-gateway-prod (service: api-gateway). Alert threshold breached: 5xx > 5% for 2m. Paging oncall.
maria_oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Seeing alerts in Grafana too. Which regions are affected?
kevin_sre: US-East primary, started at ~09:22 UTC. 502/504 and some 503s. Spike lines up with a config rollout at 09:15 that changed route weight and retry policy.
hao_ml: Quick dump of envoy counters from a node:
```
cluster.api-backend.upstream_rq_5xx: 842
cluster.api-backend.upstream_rq_503: 410
cluster.api-backend.upstream_rq_pending_overflow: 120
cluster.api-backend.upstream_rq_retry: 560
```
kevin_sre: Those pending_overflow + retries smell like circuit breaker/pending request limits tripping then Envoy retrying -> cascades.
sara_platform: Confirmed — PR #4821 rolled route weight to 80/20 and enabled retries=2 for route /v1/generate around 09:14. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4821
maria_oncall: Can we disable retries quickly? If retries are amplifying load we should turn them off and restore previous route weights.
sara_platform: I can patch the route config. Proposed change (one-liner):
```
redwoodctl route patch api-gateway --route "/v1/generate" --set retries=0
redwoodctl route patch api-gateway --route "/v1/generate" --set weight.primary=100
```
maria_oncall: Do it and announce. If we need to rollback the whole PR that's next.
deploy-bot: Rolling out config change to api-gateway-prod (patch-retries-1815000000). 3 clusters targeted, 90s rolling update.
bryan_support: FYI customers are reporting 5xxs in the support queue, mostly streaming and chunked responses. Affected customers: org-342, org-119. I'm posting a short status to status.redwood.com now.
kevin_sre: Monitoring. Also want to raise `max_pending_requests` and `max_connections` on the cluster temporarily to avoid pending_overflow. Suggest values: max_pending_requests=200 (was 50), max_connections=500 (was 200).
sara_platform: Applying both changes in one patch to avoid multiple rollouts. Patch payload snippet:
```
clusters:
  - name: api-backend
    circuit_breakers:
      thresholds:
        - priority: DEFAULT
          max_connections: 500
          max_pending_requests: 200
```
maria_oncall: Good. After deploy, watch upstream_5xx and retry counters.
deploy-bot: Config apply started for cluster api-backend (patch-cb-1815000020). Staged to 3 nodes.
kevin_sre: Seeing initial drop in retry counters 2m after patch, upstream_5xx trending down from 8% -> 2.5%.
hao_ml: Logs show fewer 503s, but one backend still returning 502s intermittently. Possibly a backend instance with bad health checks.
maria_oncall: I'll cordon the problematic backend instance id=instance-12 in US-East and drain it.
sara_platform: Cordon + drain started: `k8s drain instance-12 --grace 30s`.
deploy-bot: Drain complete, instance-12 removed from LB rotation.
kevin_sre: Error rate now ~0.9% across US-East, retries ~30 (down from 560). Good trend.
bryan_support: Posted an update to affected customers and the public status page: "Mitigation in progress — retries disabled and config rollback in flight. Partial restoration expected within 10-15 minutes." :thumbsup:
maria_oncall: I'll hand off monitoring to Kevin for the next hour. Preparing incident record and timeline.
maria_oncall: Handoff -> @kevin_sre. I'm off to join the customer sync.
kevin_sre: Ack, taking over. Will run 15m checks and then start a root-cause follow-up. Next steps: verify why PR #4821 enabled retries and why CB thresholds were too low. Also prepare a postmortem draft.
maria_oncall: Thanks team, great quick action. I'll add the initial timeline and commands to the incident doc.
incident-bot: Incident severity: SEV-2. Duration so far: 18 minutes. No data exfiltration detected. Incident channel: #incidents. Postmortem owner assigned: kevin_sre.
kevin_sre: I'll pull logs and create a postmortem link. Adding action items: 1) revert retry defaults to 0 unless opt-in, 2) add canary for route weight changes, 3) increase circuit breaker safe defaults, 4) include retry amplification test in CI.
maria_oncall: Closing my shift; leaving followups to Kevin. :white_check_mark:
kevin_sre: Will keep monitoring. If anything spikes I'll page back immediately.
